latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Data Quality Validator.

- Validates data quality in pipelines for completeness, consistency, freshness, accuracy, and distribution anomalies.
- Profiles data sources, detects schema drift, and identifies outliers.
- Generates comprehensive quality reports with actionable expectations.
- Audits pipeline data by reading source code, schema files, and sample data.
- Supports common data quality tasks: anomaly detection, completeness checks, freshness reviews, and distribution profiling.
